description.value:
Make a melee Strike and Cast a Spell as part of the same activity. The spell may be any spell you can cast with a casting time of 3 actions or fewer, targeting whatever it normally targets.

  • If the spell requires a spell attack roll against the creature you Struck, use the Strike's attack roll for both.

From 5th level, Spellstrike costs 1 action.

Roll the Strike from your Actions tab, then cast the spell from your Spellcasting tab. From 10th a critical hit makes a spell delivered against that target critical too, and this Strike does not count against your multiple attack penalty; from 20th you may cast two spells.
